{{Quote|I have personal reservations about the methods Anavere uses, but she is very successful, and this is a war, so I have allowed her to continue.|Airen Cracken, on Tal Anavere|<ref name="CRO" />}}
'''Tal Anavere''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] with an abiding passion for art. Alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Anavere witnessed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] policies crushing free expression in numerous [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], particularly among primitive cultures for whose art she bore a particular affinity. Those policies led Anavere to revile the Empire and drove her to support the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Anavere established herself as an [[art dealer]] who traded pieces created by important members of the Imperial bureaucracy. She used her influence with such clients to extract intelligence that she passed on to the Alliance. In the period between the battles of [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Yavin]] and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]], Anavere had begun to use addictive [[Ho'Din herbal tea]]s to exert greater influence over her marks. The technique raised some concerns for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], but he allowed her to continue working for the Alliance due to her ongoing effectiveness.

==Biography==
Tal Anavere was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]], [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]]. She developed a passion for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] art, with a particular affinity for artworks from pre-technological civilizations. Under the regime of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Anavere witnessed the artistic traditions of primitive cultures in many [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] curtailed or destroyed by Imperial [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] or domination. Believing the policies of the Empire crushed freedom of expression, Anavere became a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]], [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]], and [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]], eventually affiliating herself with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CRO" />

As a Rebel operative, Anavere operated as an [[art dealer]] and specialized in trading artworks created by important members of the Imperial bureaucracy&mdash;there being no market in the Empire for her preferred, pre-technological art forms. Many of those Imperials, jaded by the experience of individuals purchasing their art simply to curry favor, came to trust Anavere as she made them feel their works were being purchased by individuals with a genuine interest in the pieces. Anavere used her positions of trust to gather intelligence for the Rebel Alliance, but she also took more direct action to remove [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] placed on Rebel heads and arrange amnesties. Anavere avoided reprisals from the Empire by utilizing multiple aliases, erasing records of her previous activities and, on occasion, faking reports of her own [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="CRO" />

In the period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Anavere established an art gallery, [["Sophistication"]], on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]],<ref name="CRO" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known for its massive [[Celebratus Archive|library database]].<ref name="HTESB">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> She also began using slightly addictive blends of [[Ho'Din herbal tea]]s on her Imperial marks to increase her influence over them. That technique came to the attention of [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], a [[General/Legends|general]] and member of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Cracken was one of several high-ranking Alliance members who expressed reservations over Anavere's use of herbal [[Tea/Legends|teas]]; however, Cracken respected her abilities enough to include a file on the Ho'Din in his [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on useful Alliance operatives.<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Fortunately, she chooses only to use her Ho'Din herbal teas on Imperials who are guilty of far worse atrocities.|Airen Cracken, on Tal Anavere|<ref name="CRO" />}}
Tal Anavere was a Ho'Din,<ref name="CRO" /> a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the planet [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and distinguished by tresses of vibrantly-[[Color/Legends|colored]] head tendrils.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> Anavere lacked morals and had little respect for sentients, whether alive or dead; her sole concern was for art. Her passion for art eventually spawned a hatred for the Galactic Empire, as she witnessed numerous examples of free expression crushed by its policies. However, when dealing with Imperial clients, Anavere was effective in hiding that emotion, and she was able to convince many Imperials that their talentless artworks were genuinely appreciated. The Ho'Din was described as a "very unpleasant being" in her Alliance file, but despite that, Cracken continued to sanction her activities.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Anavere was knowledgeable about different cultures, art, and herbal medicine, and was skilled enough botanically to cultivate addictive strains of herbal teas. The Ho'Din was a gifted bargainer, con artist, and gambler, and was adept at [[Knife/Legends|knife]] fighting.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
In addition to operating her own art gallery, Anavere possessed a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing information on galactic art history, a deck of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] cards, a jeweled [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Rodian ceremonial dagger|ceremonial]] [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]], and a collection of herbal teas. On at least one occasion, Anavere wore a loose-fitting, light-colored dress and a scarf.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tal Anavere was created by [[Chuck Truett]] for the [[1994]] [[West End Games]] publication ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. An illustration by [[Mike Vilardi]] accompanied her one-page entry in the book.<ref name="CRO" />
